title: Localization Does Not Imply Steerability: A Mechanistic Study of Sign Errors in LLM Mathematics
abstract: arXiv:2611.07478v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When large language models do multi-step mathematics, a characteristic failure recurs: the model writes one wrong sign token mid-computation -- a cofactor sign, the minus of a recursive integration-by-parts step -- then executes the rest of the arithmetic correctly, and the answer comes out wrong. We ask where inside the network that sign is written. Across six open models spanning 14B to 675B parameters, a per-layer readout shows the wrong sign is committed late -- by MLP layers in the last quarter of the network (70-100% per model and task), a pattern present, where tested (Qwen), in the base model before instruction tuning. The mechanism varies: some models carry fixed "minus-stamp" layers that push a minus regardless of the right answer, others carry amplifiers of whichever sign was already chosen, and Qwen adds a downstream rescue layer that opposes the stamp. The circuit is causal: subtracting a single sign direction from the res

translated_title: 定位并不意味着可操控性：LLM数学中符号错误的机制研究
translated_abstract: 当大语言模型进行多步数学运算时，一种特征性的失败反复出现：模型在计算中途写下一个错误的符号token——例如余子式的符号、递归分部积分步骤中的负号——随后正确执行其余的算术运算，但最终答案出错。我们探究这个符号在网络内部是在何处写下的。在涵盖14B至675B参数的六个开源模型中，逐层读出实验表明，错误的符号是在计算后期产生的——由网络最后四分之一区段的MLP层所为（每个模型和任务中占比70-100%），且在经过测试的情况下（Qwen），这一模式在指令微调之前的基础模型中就已存在。具体机制因模型而异：一些模型带有固定的“负号盖章”层，无论正确答案如何都会推出负号；另一些模型则带有对已选定符号的放大器；而Qwen还额外增加了一个下游的“救援层”来对抗这种盖章。该回路是因果性的：从残差流中减去单一符号方向（后文截断）……
tldr: 该研究通过逐层因果分析揭示了LLM在多步数学中的符号错误主要由网络后四分之一区段的MLP层在后期产生，且不同模型具有不同机制（固定的“负号盖章”层、符号放大器、救援层），同时指出即便能精确定位错误来源，也不意味着能够有效操控和纠正它。
en_tdlr: This study mechanistically localizes sign errors in LLM multi-step mathematics to late-quarter MLP layers, identifying model-specific mechanisms such as fixed "minus-stamp" layers, sign amplifiers, and rescue layers, while showing that localization does not imply steerability.
